title: Fix flash-agent CLI: exit code 1, MCP transport not connecting (0613-0617 follow-up)
description: Root cause: the /__agent WebSocket bridge is a singleton. With 8 parallel Playwright workers, each worker's page.goto('/') disconnected the previous worker's bridge, producing 'Editor page disconnected before responding' errors. Fix: added workers:1 to playwright.config.ts to serialise the full E2E suite. Results: 15/15 flash-agent CLI tests passing, 68/69 total (1 remaining failure is the pre-existing onClipEvent(load) pixelDiff=0 under task 0663).
